site.title: Outsourced payroll for multi-site employers | Harbourline
site.description: Harbourline Payroll runs weekly and monthly payroll, leave records and payslips from Ho Chi Minh City for employers with staff across several sites.

data.title: Payroll for employers with *staff on many sites*
data.lead: Harbourline Payroll runs weekly and monthly pay runs, leave records and payslips from Ho Chi Minh City, with a named payroll lead for every client.

data.title: One payroll record across *every site*
paragraphs: Harbourline Payroll works for employers whose staff clock in at several sites: clinics, warehouses and retail stores. We keep **one record per employee** across all of them, so transfers and shared shifts are paid once and paid right.
Each client has a **named payroll lead** and a second checker. The lead answers your questions; the checker reviews every pay run before it is released.

points.title: Weekly or monthly
points.text: Pay runs on the cycle your staff are used to.

points.title: Second check
points.text: A second person reviews every run before payment.

points.title: Leave records
points.text: Annual and sick leave kept up to date each pay run.

cards.title: Pay runs
cards.text: Weekly, fortnightly or monthly pay runs with overtime, allowances and deductions.

cards.title: Leave records
cards.text: Annual, sick and unpaid leave updated with every pay run.

cards.title: Payslips and reports
cards.text: Payslips by email and a cost report for each site after every run.

cards.title: Starters and leavers
cards.text: New staff set up before their first shift and final pay worked out on time.

data.title: From timesheets to payslips in *four steps*
data.lead: The same four steps run every pay cycle, so your site managers always know what is due and when.

steps.title: Sites send timesheets
steps.text: Each site manager uploads hours or exports them from your rostering tool.

steps.title: We check the hours
steps.text: Your payroll lead matches hours to rosters and asks about anything unusual.

steps.title: A second person reviews
steps.text: A checker reviews rates, overtime and deductions before the run is released.

steps.title: Staff get payslips
steps.text: Payments go out on the agreed day and every employee receives a payslip by email.

data.title: Move your next pay run to *Harbourline*
data.text: We run one cycle alongside your current process so you can compare the results.

data.blurb: Harbourline Payroll runs payroll from Ho Chi Minh City for employers with staff on several sites.
